headline: Subshell 1.0.3: a copy sheet, your own start feed, a steadier Inbox and better moderator tools
highlights: Reading: one "Copy…" entry on posts and comments opens a sheet to copy the text, select part of it, copy the link, or pick any link in the text.
Reading: choose your start feed (Home, Popular or All) and the default sort for feeds and communities in Settings > Feeds & content > Feeds.
Reading: links to replies deep down a long thread open at the reply, and a post opened from a link comes back after Android has closed the app.
Inbox: a chat text sent right after an image stays in the same row, image messages read as text, and the Inbox keeps its place and selection for each account.
Inbox: when Reddit does not confirm a chat image, Subshell checks before you send again and gives the image back if it never arrived.
Inbox: an expired chat sign-in offers Sign in again, and New message finds a user by their exact name.
Inbox: a reply typed in a notification is stored encrypted while it waits to be sent, and says so in the notification if it could not be sent.
Moderation: mod queue cards show why an item is there (report reasons, "Held by AutoModerator", who removed it and why) with a picture, flair and age.
Moderation: picking a removal reason with a message switches the removal message on with that text. You can still turn it off.
Modmail: a reply is never sent twice, a failed action says what failed, an unsent reply is kept when you close the conversation, and a notification tap opens the conversation.
If something does not work for you, tell us on r/subshell or GitHub.
